title: Florida Man Learns Why Running From Cops Is a BAD Idea
description:
Bodycams caught the moment a Florida man allegedly took off on police during a traffic stop in Marion County, and left a toddler behind when he abandoned the vehicle and ran into the woods. Police took Jordan Skeene, 24, a convicted felon, into custody. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
